OpsPhone.intro: Connect the ops-phone FiveM phone. Requests from its Services app (911, EMS, mechanic, taxi) become CAD calls, and the caller gets a text when units are assigned and when the call is closed.
OpsPhone.enabledDescription: When off, the webhook answers 404 and nothing is sent to the phone.
OpsPhone.phoneApiIntro: The CAD uses the phone's REST API to update requests and text the caller. Use the address of your FiveM server as the CAD's API can reach it.
OpsPhone.apiKeySetPlaceholder: Leave empty to keep the saved key
OpsPhone.apiKeySet: A key is saved. Type a new one to replace it.
OpsPhone.saveFirstHint: Save your changes before you test the connection.
OpsPhone.test_unauthorizedDetails: The phone refused the key. Copy opslabs_phone_api_key from server.cfg again.
OpsPhone.test_apiDisabledDetails: Set opslabs_phone_api_key (24 or more characters) in server.cfg and restart ops-phone.
OpsPhone.test_errorDetails: The phone answered with an error. Check the URL ends with /opslabs-phone/api/v1.
OpsPhone.test_notConfiguredDetails: Set the phone API URL and save first.
OpsPhone.test_noKeyDetails: Set the API key and save first.
OpsPhone.webhookIntro: ops-phone sends each service request to this address. The secret proves it comes from your server.
OpsPhone.regenerateConfirm: Make a new secret? The old one stops working until you update server.cfg.
OpsPhone.stepApiConfig: In opslabs-phone/server/api_config.lua, add this line to the Webhooks list:
OpsPhone.stepApiKey: Make sure server.cfg has set opslabs_phone_api_key "..." and paste the same key above.
OpsPhone.stepRestart: Restart the server (or ensure opslabs-phone) so the phone reads the new settings.
OpsPhone.servicesIntro: Choose what each phone service creates in the CAD. The number is the service's number in the phone; texts to the caller come from it.
OpsPhone.sendSmsDescription: Send the caller a text when units are assigned and when the call is closed.
